T: › to cause something or someone to be unbalanced
› to make someone mentally ill, especially temporarily
› to make something unfair or not equal
使不公平；使偏頗；使不平等

example: The result was to further unbalance the monetary-fiscal policy mix.
結果將使貨幣—財政政策組合更加失衡。

NONE: › not firm but likely to fall or change position suddenly
不均衡的；失去平衡的
C2 mentally ill
精神失常的
C2 not fair or equal; false
不公平的；偏頗的；片面的
› not consisting of a combination of the correct types and amounts of food
（飲食）不均衡的，營養搭配不合理的

example: His relatives have said he became unbalanced after the death of his father.
親戚們說他在父親去世後就精神失常了。
He gave an unbalanced view of the situation.
他對該局勢發表了有傾向性的觀點。
an unbalanced diet
不均衡的飲食
an unbalanced meal
營養不均衡的膳食

NONE: B2 too painful or unpleasant for you to continue to experience
無法忍受的

example: All I remember of my daughter's birth was the unbearable pain and the relief when it was all over.
生我女兒給我留下的記憶就是無法忍受的疼痛和一切結束後的輕鬆。
The atmosphere at work at the moment is almost unbearable.
目前的工作氛圍真令人難以忍受。
The heat was unbearable.
熱得令人難以忍受。

NONE: › unable to be defeated or improved because of excellent quality
無法戰勝的；不能超越的

example: The 23-year-old US tennis star looks unbeatable this season.
這位23歲的美國網球明星在這個賽季似乎所向無敵。
For good pizzas at a reasonable price they're unbeatable.
要論批薩的味道鮮美、價格公道，誰也比不上他們。

NONE: › in sports, having won every game
（在體育比賽中）保持全勝的，未嘗敗績的

example: Manchester United remain unbeaten this season so far.
曼聯隊本賽季到目前爲止保持全勝紀錄。

NONE: › formal Unbecoming clothes do not look attractive on a particular person.
（衣著）不合身的，不相配的，難看的
› Unbecoming behaviour is not correct or not acceptable.
（行爲）不恰當的，不得體的，不可接受的

example: He was charged with conduct unbecoming (to) an officer.
他被控行爲有失軍官身份。

NONE: › without a particular person knowing
在（某人）不知道的情況下

example: Unbeknownst to me, he had rented out the apartment while I was away.
他趁我不在的時候把公寓租了出去，我根本不知情。

NONE: B1 extremely surprising
令人震驚的，難以置信的
B2 unable to be believed because unlikely
不能相信的；離譜的

example: She eats an unbelievable amount of food.
她的食量驚人。
You've had such bad luck it's unbelievable.
你的運氣這麽差，真是令人難以置信。
You should see her wardrobe - it's unbelievable - she's got about 50 pairs of shoes.
你該看看她的衣櫃——真是不可思議——她有大約50雙鞋。
I thought most of the characters in the play were totally unbelievable.
我發現該劇中的大多數角色都完全不可信。

NONE: › in a way that is very surprising or difficult to believe
令人難以置信地

example: He works unbelievably hard.
他工作極其賣力。
It was still an unbelievably stupid thing to do.
要做的這件事仍然是愚蠢至極，令人難以置信。

NONE: › a person who does not have any religious beliefs
無宗教信仰者，不信教者

example: Most church schools are open to unbelievers.
大多數教會學校都會招收不信教的人。

NONE: › to relax and become less formal and serious in your manner
放鬆，變得隨意

example: I'd hoped that after a glass or two of wine she might unbend a little.
我曾希望一兩杯酒下肚後她可能會放鬆一點兒。

NONE: › If someone is unbending, they often make fixed judgments and decisions that they are unwilling to change.
固執的；倔強的；堅定的

example: He has earned a reputation as a stern and unbending politician.
作爲政治家，他以強硬和不妥協而聞名。

NONE: C2 able to judge fairly because you are not influenced by your own opinions
無偏見的，公正的

example: an unbiased opinion
不偏不倚的觀點

NONE: › not invited or wanted
未被邀請的；未經要求的；自發的

example: At night, images would come unbidden into her mind.
晚上種種形象會自動浮現在她的腦海裡。

NONE: › to release someone or something from a rope, string, etc. that has been tying him, her, or it up
解開（繩索）

example: My hands were unbound and my blindfold removed.
我手上的繩子被解開了，我的眼罩也被拿掉了。

NONE: › Unbleached flour or material is not made white artificially by the use of chemicals.
（麵粉或材料）未被漂白的，本色的
› An unblemished reputation, character, etc. has no faults and is not spoiled in any way.
（名聲等）無瑕疵的，無汙點的

example: For six years his championship record was unblemished.
他的冠軍紀錄有六年無任何瑕疵。

NONE: › looking straight at someone or something in a steady way without blinking (= closing and opening your eyes quickly)
不眨眼的

example: He leaned threateningly towards me and fixed me with an unblinking stare.
他以威脅的姿態向我探過身來，一眼不眨地盯著我。

NONE: › to clear something by removing something that is blocking it
疏通；掃除…的障礙
› to make it possible to use a phone, website, etc. again
（電話，網站等）解鎖

example: to unblock a pipe/drain/toilet
疏通管道／水溝／廁所
He's having an operation to unblock two of his arteries.
他正在接受手術，疏通兩條動脈。
Learn how you can unblock a phone number or remove it from the Auto Reject List.
學習如何給一個電話號碼解鎖，或是將它從自動拒絕名單上移除。

NONE: › not yet born; in the mother's womb
未出生的

example: the protection of the unborn child
對胎兒的保護

NONE: › used to describe a positive feeling that is very great and seems to have no limits
（積極情感）極大的，無限的

example: her unbounded enthusiasm for her subject
她對自己所學科目的極大熱忱

NONE: › impossible to break
無法打破的，牢不可破的
› used for describing differences or divisions between people that are so big they will never be made smaller
（分歧）無法彌合的，（差異）無法縮小的

example: There is an unbridgeable divide between the country's two main political camps.
這個國家的兩大政治陣營之間對立嚴重，無法調和。

NONE: › not controlled or limited
不受控制的；無限的
› continuous and with no pauses
連續的；無停頓的

example: The Giants' winning streak remained unbroken for an impressive 19 games.
巨人隊的連勝紀錄保持了19場，令人驚歎。

NONE: › to release the buckle (= metal fastener) of a shoe, belt, etc. so that you can remove it
解開…扣；鬆開
› to free yourself of something that is worrying you, by talking about it to someone
傾訴自己的煩惱；訴苦

example: He'll unburden himself to anyone who'll listen.
他會向任何願意聽的人傾訴自己的煩惱。
